title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: PPAC Reporting API
description:
Power Platform reporting API for Copilot credits provides customers with access to Copilot Credit usage from Copilot Studio through the Power Platform API, extending the existing reports available in the Power Platform Admin Center.

Details of the API methods are available in the Microsoft Power Platform API reference - Power Platform API | Microsoft Learn, providing insights into usage by resource, environment, user, and feature. New reports and capabilities will continue to be released.

These reports can be used with Power Platform API credit allocations to monitor and optimize resources and environments that consume Copilot Credits.
